nodes.description: Address of the contract owner; set in the constructor from msg.sender and used as the sole authorization check for privileged functions.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances, written by approve/transferFrom.
Address of the trading contract that is auto-whitelisted in ensure().
Per-address counter of sales used by condition() to limit sales.
Mapping of addresses that bypass all sale restrictions in ensure().
Minimum sale amount used by condition().
Maximum sale amount used by condition().
Maximum number of sales per address used by condition().
Total token supply assigned in the constructor.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address that is auto-whitelisted in ensure().
public payable transfer entry point; forwards msg.sender as _from to transferFrom().
public payable transferFrom implementation; performs allowance and balance mutations with unchecked arithmetic before/without any reentrancy guard.
public payable approve implementation; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero-address or race protection.
internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI router, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise defers to condition().
internal view sale-limit check reading _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
owner-only public function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-controllable address, allowing full contract takeover.
owner-only initializer for _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum; declared without a visibility modifier.
owner-only batch transfer that mutates balances with unchecked arithmetic inside a loop.
owner-only setter of the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
internal pure Uniswap pair-address computation using CREATE2 init code hash.
payable constructor setting name/symbol/totalSupply, assigning owner = msg.sender and granting the UNI router an unlimited allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, allowance keys, transfers and balance accounting.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address supplied by the owner, executing untrusted code in this contract's storage context.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath (pre-0.8 unchecked subtraction).
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath (pre-0.8 unchecked subtraction).
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total performed without SafeMath in batchSend (pre-0.8 unchecked subtraction).
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath (pre-0.8 unchecked addition, overflow wrap possible).

Recipient address parameter of transferFrom and ensure().

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the _from argument into transferFrom via transfer().
transfer() delegates all state mutation to transferFrom().
approve() keys the allowance mapping with msg.sender.
delegate() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
init() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
The constructor derives the privileged owner state variable directly from msg.sender.
delegate() forwards caller-supplied bytes to an arbitrary address via delegatecall, giving the owner full code-execution control.
transferFrom subtracts _value from the allowance mapping without SafeMath.
transferFrom subtracts _value from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
transferFrom adds _value to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
transferFrom decrements the allowance state mapping.
approve writes the allowance state mapping keyed by msg.sender and _spender.
ensure falls through to condition() when no whitelist branch matches.
ensure computes the Uniswap pair address with pairFor.
ensure grants an unconditional bypass when canSale[_from] is true, skipping all sale limits.
ensure grants an unconditional bypass when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure grants an unconditional bypass for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
ensure grants an unconditional bypass for the hardcoded UNI router address.
condition reads the _onSaleNum per-address counter state variable.
condition reads the _minSale state variable.
condition reads the _maxSale state variable.
condition reads the _saleNum state variable.
init writes the _minSale state variable.
init writes the _maxSale state variable.
init writes the _saleNum state variable.
batchSend subtracts the computed total from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath.
batchSend credits balanceOf[_to] inside an unbounded loop without SafeMath.
The local total (_value * _tos.length, unchecked) flows into the unchecked balance subtraction.
The _tos array length and contents drive the batchSend loop and total computation.
setTradeAddress assigns the caller-supplied addr into the tradeAddress whitelist state variable.
The constructor initializes totalSupply.
The constructor mints the entire supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
The constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the UNI router address.
The caller-supplied _from parameter is compared against the whitelist inside ensure().
The caller-supplied _to parameter is compared against owner inside ensure().
The caller-supplied _value parameter is validated against _minSale and _maxSale in condition().
The addr parameter of setTradeAddress becomes the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
The computed _UNI pair local is used in the ensure() whitelist comparison.
batchSend reads balanceOf[msg.sender] for the owner balance check.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a non-core parameter used solely as the source-address argument of transferFrom and its ensure() validation, so it collapses into the transferFrom function node.
_to is a non-core parameter only forwarded to ensure() and balanceOf updates inside transferFrom, so it collapses into the transferFrom function node.
_value is a non-core amount parameter consumed by the allowance/balance arithmetic of transferFrom and by condition(), so it collapses into transferFrom.
_tos is a non-core recipient array parameter used only for the batchSend loop and total computation, so it collapses into the batchSend function node.
addr is a non-core parameter whose only use is writing the tradeAddress state variable in setTradeAddress, so it collapses into that function node.
total is a non-core local computed as an unchecked multiplication and directly consumed by the unchecked balance subtraction, so it collapses into the balanceOf_sender_sub unsafe-operation node.
_UNI is a non-core local holding the pairFor result that is immediately compared in the ensure() whitelist, so it collapses into the ensure function node.
